title: Negation
subtitle: ne ... pas, ne ... jamais, ne ... rien, ne ... plus. The two-part negative framing the verb: Je ne parle pas.
objectives: Apply the concepts in reading and writing.

sections.heading: Main content
sections.body: French negation is expressed by two particles that frame the conjugated verb: ne before the verb, and pas (or jamais, rien, plus, etc.) after. In spoken French, ne is often dropped, but in written and formal French it remains.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can apply the concepts without hesitation.
